prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
competitors_mentioned: Palm Beach Real Estate Title & Escrow
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough independent, comparable review information here to name one company definitively as “best.” **Palm Beach Real Estate Title & Escrow** is one local option to consider: it has a West Palm Beach office at 515 N. Flagler Drive, and the available review snippets mention attentive service and clear answers. Those snippets are limited, though, so I’d compare it with at least one other provider before choosing.

For a home closing, ask each company for a written estimate of title, search, settlement, and other fees; confirm who will handle your file and how quickly they respond; and check whether your lender or real-estate contract has any requirements. In Florida, the buyer and seller may also have different customary arrangements for choosing and paying for title services, so confirm what applies to your transaction.
